appearances.title: OpenBMB/ForgeKernel
appearances.summary: The 22-hour live run ended with version 31 at 472 vs 518 microseconds on DeepSeek V4.1 FlashMLA prefill, without the agent seeing FlashMLA's source. OpenBMB is releasing the optimized fused prefill kernel, the kernels from its ForgeKernel paper (matching or beating 18 of 22 expert-library kernels) and the optimization harness.
